# OP Troops

**Version 1.2** · for Crusader Kings III 1.20.* · [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2231435851) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [All versions](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=op-troops&expanded=true)

Five hundred soldiers who do not lose.

This mod adds three regiment types and several ways to conjure them out of thin
air. They are not balanced units. They are not meant to be. They are what you
reach for when you want a war to simply be over.

---

## Three flavours

| Regiment | Built on |
|---|---|
| **Immortal Army** | Heavy infantry. The all-rounder, and the original. |
| **Immortal Riders** | Heavy cavalry. Runs down anything that breaks. |
| **Immortal Bowmen** | Archers. Opens the battle before a line is even formed. |

All three have identical, ridiculous numbers. What differs is what the game
thinks they are, which decides how enemy regiments counter them and how they
behave in each phase of a battle. Pick whichever suits the war you are ending.

## What you get

**500 soldiers** per spawn, with numbers that are frankly rude:

- **1000 Damage** and **1000 Toughness**
- **1000 Pursuit** and **1000 Screen**, so nothing escapes them and
  nothing gets past them
- **+100 Damage in every terrain in the game** — no bad ground, anywhere
- **Counters everything**: archers, skirmishers, pikemen, heavy infantry,
  light cavalry and heavy cavalry all count against them for nothing
- **Siege tier 4**, so walls stop mattering
- **Completely free** — no purchase cost and no upkeep, ever
- **No supply needs**, so they never suffer attrition

For scale, an ordinary heavy infantry regiment sits in the tens for damage and
toughness. These are at a thousand.

## How to summon them

Right-click any character, choose **Open Immortal Army Menu**, and all six
options appear: each of the three regiments, inheritable or not. Close the menu
when you are done so it is not cluttering every right-click.

This works on yourself too -- right-click your own portrait. An army raised as
**inheritable** passes to your heirs; one raised otherwise dies with its
owner.

Arming a favourite vassal, or an ally you would like to see win, works exactly
as well as arming yourself.

## Things to know

- **They spawn at the capital** of whoever receives them.
- **They cannot be recruited normally.** None of the three appear in your
  men-at-arms screen to buy; the only way to get them is through this mod.
- **The AI never uses this.** It is a player tool only, so the world around
  you is not suddenly full of invincible armies.
- **They are not literally immortal.** They can technically be killed. It
  just takes some doing.

## Compatibility

- Built and tested against **CK3 1.19 "Scribe"**.
- **Ironman and achievements:** this mod will disable achievements, as
  gameplay mods do.
- **Other mods:** it adds three regiment types and eight interactions, and overwrites no base game file.
- **Existing saves:** safe to add mid-game. Removing the mod while an
  Immortal Army exists will leave a broken regiment in that save, so disband
  them first.

## Languages

Available in all nine languages the game supports. English is fully written;
the other eight currently show the English wording. Translations are welcome.

## Install

- **Steam Workshop:** subscribe on the Workshop page above.
- **Manually, any version:** download `op-troops-v<version>.zip` from the [releases](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=op-troops&expanded=true) and extract it into `Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/`, then enable it in the launcher.
